problem: Agent git operations destroyed coordinator-recorded project memory, and an unreviewed permission expansion is invisible to every project gate.
evidence: Ledger destruction reproduced in an isolated scratch repository: a tracked ledger dropped to zero records after git stash while a skip-worktree ledger survived, and git stash list ended empty
.claude/hooks/block-dangerous-command.mjs lines 5-21 verified directly by the coordinator: git stash absent
.claude/settings.local.json allow list verified directly by the coordinator
grep shows no reference to settings.local in scan-agent-config-security.mjs or validate-claude-config.mjs
validate:claude reported 14 errors, 9 of them from files inside a nested agent worktree under .claude
options: Hook guard on git stash and git worktree add under .claude
Isolate every specialist into a worktree by default
Ledger integrity checker that detects truncation after the fact
recommendation: Hook guard first, then permission surface, then validator scope, then ledger durability. Documentation was proven insufficient because CLAUDE.md already forbade destructive git operations. Permission narrowing alone cannot help because git stash is in neither the allow nor the ask list and already passed an interactive prompt. Detection after unrecoverable loss is strictly weaker than prevention.
rootCauseHypotheses: block-dangerous-command.mjs enumerates fifteen destructive patterns but omits git stash. settings.local.json grants Bash(node *), Bash(npm run *), Bash(git checkout *), Bash(git add *) and is read by neither the security scanner nor the config validator. Nested agent worktrees under .claude are walked by the English-only rule, turning validate:claude and the self-test red.
rollback: Delete the added hook array entries and restore the previous settings.local.json allow list; each change is a few lines and additive.
pilotPlan: Three relevant tasks in which a specialist needs to test whether a failure is pre-existing and must reach the safe alternative instead of git stash, plus one negative case confirming git stash list and git stash show remain allowed.

problem: assertEnglishInternalFiles in scripts/validate-claude-config.mjs encodes an authoring-language policy but implements it as a whole-file character scan over eight directory trees, with no concept of provenance. Append-only machine-written evidence registries that correctly quote real product artefacts, such as the test title 'QARGA10 promo kodu artiq endirim vermir (DEC-0002)' and UI copy from src/i18n/translations.ts, therefore fail the same gate that governs authored agent prompts. The language rule and the evidence-integrity rule became mutually unsatisfiable, and the language rule won.
evidence: scripts/validate-claude-config.mjs lines 68-85: whole-file single-hit boolean regex, invoked once at line 548; walk() at lines 16-26 has no ignore list
Four tracked files failed on seven lines total: .claude/performance/ledger.jsonl, .claude/tasks/contracts.jsonl, .claude/work-os/events.jsonl, .claude/work-os/state.json
The product-name allowlist already covers Qarga and Lelek, so product names were never the trigger; ordinary vocabulary inside quoted evidence was
git clone of main into a scratch directory then node scripts/validate-claude-config.mjs exits 0, proving CI was green and the failure was local only
git ls-files -v reports skip-worktree on all four failing files, which is why git status showed no change and an earlier inference that the files were byte-identical to HEAD was wrong
Committed HEAD sizes are 208, 0, 0 and 137 bytes against local sizes of 11677, 34442, 25779 and 66792 bytes

scripts/generate-agent-ops-dashboard.mjs copies Work OS subtask titles into docs/agent-ops/dashboard.html and scripts/review-work-os.mjs copies decisionRequired.summary into .claude/work-os/review.json, so the same failure will recur in generated artefacts
rootCauseHypotheses: Confirmed: the rule has no provenance model, so authored configuration and machine-written evidence are treated identically
Confirmed secondary: unbounded scan roots make the verdict environment dependent, producing ten phantom errors from an untracked local worktree
Rejected: the product-name allowlist is incomplete. Verified false; Qarga and Lelek are already substituted before the test

Rejected: the writer scripts should sanitise on the write path. Transliterating evidence would break grep parity against server/test.mjs and src/i18n/translations.ts and would falsify quoted QA evidence
options: A: exempt machine-written evidence registries and generated operational artefacts from the language rule
B: allow the product language only inside quoted string values; rejected because nearly all human text in JSON lives in string values, so it is A with an illusion of strictness
C: expand the approved-name allowlist; rejected because the allowlist is applied globally and every added word would legalise that word inside agent prompts forever
D: restrict scan roots so untracked local folders cannot produce phantom errors; needed, but does not fix the tracked files and cannot be the primary change
E: change the CLAUDE.md wording only; necessary as a companion but not executable on its own
F: rewrite the four evidence files; rejected on policy because it falsifies quoted evidence and is the ledger-mutation class that DEC-0003 exists to prevent
recommendation: Option A scoped to append-only machine-written registries under .claude plus a short explicit list of generated operational artefacts, with a mandatory self-test negative control proving authored files remain enforced, and a one-sentence CLAUDE.md clarification so the executable gate and the written contract agree. Option D follows as a separate smaller subtask in the same file.
rollback: Single revert across scripts/validate-claude-config.mjs, scripts/test-claude-system.mjs and CLAUDE.md. The exemption is read-side only, so no data written meanwhile becomes invalid.
pilotPlan: Observe the next three tasks that append product-language evidence to a registry. Acceptance is that validate:claude stays green across all three and that no agent proposes transliterating evidence to satisfy the gate. Then decide KEEP, REVISE or REVERT.
